youtube_title: Car Sinking in a Canal: Force the Door or Open the Window? Brave vs Normal #19 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL, WHO'S RIGHT? #19. At night a car falls into a canal and water is coming in. Brave pushes the door with full force. Normal unbuckles, rolls the window down at once and gets out through the window. Comment B or N.
Answer: NORMAL. Water pressure outside keeps the door shut, and you have roughly the first minute while the car floats. Seatbelt off, window open, children out first, then get out and up (S-W-C-O). If the window won't open, break a side window; keep an escape hammer in the car. Don't spend the time on the phone.
Source: Prof. Gordon Giesbrecht, University of Manitoba (NPR, 2024). General awareness.
